scope: Only four owner-specified candidates; bounded metadata/source review
allowed_retrievals: Git tree and blob metadata, README, license and published processing-source text
Figshare/Zenodo deposit descriptors; Crossref article license metadata
UniProt explicitly requested domain/Pfam/accession fields; RCSB polymer-entity metadata
excluded_retrievals: Whole MaveDB score-set JSON, score endpoints, clinical values and distributions
json_projection: Deposit/article top-level whitelist selected lexically before decoding excluded descriptions; only selected license/file-descriptor fields retained. No outcome endpoints queried.
metadata_transport: Raw descriptor HTTP responses transit memory; excluded description strings not semantically decoded or persisted. No linked payload fetched.
method_source_review: Author scripts read as text, not executed. Source statements are not result outputs; incidental inline missingness comment separately disclosed.
network_errors: Initial sandbox urllib DNS failure; retried through approved network escalation
web open of three known metadata/landing URLs failed; direct approved metadata endpoints succeeded; no label fallback
CI: Commit skip marker used so preexisting push/PR workflows do not replay outcome data or run model tests. No workflow file modified.
